crossRefs.note: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax…
The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax…
Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have…
The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.
When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

translations.web: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
translations.bsb: And all who saw this began to grumble, saying, “He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!”
translations.kjv: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
translations.asv: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, He is gone in to lodge with a man that is a sinner.
